mutagen.role.zombie: Durable night fighter. Recover in darkness; daylight and slow movement punish careless travel.
mutagen.role.skeleton: Fragile ranged hunter. Mark targets and fire volleys; avoid explosions and sunlight.
mutagen.role.creeper: Armored ambusher. Create space, hide, then spend health on a powerful blast that leaves blocks intact.
mutagen.role.spider: Climbing skirmisher. Pounce, poison and immobilize; fire becomes more dangerous.
mutagen.role.enderman: Mobile duelist. Blink past danger and control nearby enemies; water and rain hurt.
mutagen.role.drowned: Aquatic controller. Dash and pull enemies underwater; prolonged dry travel becomes dangerous.
mutagen.role.blaze: Flying fire support. Strong against fire, vulnerable to water and projectiles; attacks need dry conditions.
mutagen.role.phantom: Night scout. Take off, hide in darkness and strike by diving into a target; sunlight burns.
mutagen.role.bee: Flying pollinator. Helps crops grow, uses a costly close sting, and calls nearby bees against its attacker.
mutagen.role.wolf: Pack hunter. Track prey and bite on contact; meat sustains you and llamas frighten you.
mutagen.role.piglin: Nether warrior. Fight with weapons and rally nearby piglins; gold greed and exile have a price.
mutagen.role.guardian: Aquatic defender. Swim freely and see clearly underwater; on land, hop, struggle to see and run out of air.
